about: Every lesson a reviewed Motif reel taught. motif_lessons.CHECKS runs the 'check' lessons on every new reel; the others name the pipeline stage or brief rule that enforces them. Add lessons with: python scripts/motif_improve.py lesson ...

lessons.symptom: Five reels all looked alike
lessons.rule: Each film gets its own look (palette family, rooms, headline, captions, camera, transitions) and the cross-film variety check must pass

lessons.symptom: Machines were decoration; labels did the explaining (bus under INSIDE EVERY PHONE)
lessons.rule: Every claim beat declares a relation and its machine must show that relation; labels name the claim's own nouns

lessons.symptom: No real product on screen
lessons.rule: When a brief names a product, its vendored mark appears on the hook, the machines and the end card

lessons.symptom: 6-7 frame entrances after each cut; sets restarted mid-beat
lessons.rule: Hard cuts with a complete, moving scene on frame 1; one set per idea, continuing shots never re-enter

lessons.symptom: Quieter than the references, gaps in the audio
lessons.rule: Mix near -14 LUFS with the original music bed ducked under the voice, no gaps

lessons.symptom: Headlines sat too long
lessons.rule: The headline changes at least every 3 s

lessons.symptom: Python's lock opened before the narration finished explaining the restriction
lessons.rule: A machine shows the change only when the narration reaches it; use visual.hold for setup beats

lessons.symptom: Attractive metaphors that did not demonstrate the claim; the certificate lost its identity between beats
lessons.rule: Keep objects and consequences connected: the same object carries forward and its change demonstrates the claim

lessons.symptom: The Python lock was pink in one beat and teal in the next
lessons.rule: Beats that carry the same machine keep its colours; vary only walls and floor with an object/room palette

lessons.symptom: ANSWERS WITH SOURCES then ANSWERS GET SAVED read as one 4.3 s headline
lessons.rule: Consecutive headlines never open with the same word

lessons.symptom: A front crate hid the wiki board's PAGES counter
lessons.rule: Front set dressing never covers a machine label

lessons.symptom: Wiki page titles were small on a phone
lessons.rule: Machine labels are at least 24 px tall in the 1080 x 1920 delivery

lessons.symptom: hook item tags clip their labels (BOOK NOT, PODCA) when drawn at 1.4x in forget mode
lessons.rule: Machine labels must fit their tag at the drawn scale; no clipped words

lessons.symptom: One vault room held from 0:12 to 0:40 while the references change setting every 2-3 s
lessons.rule: Consecutive beats never share a set; carry the object between sets instead

lessons.symptom: Two-line headline cards took 15% of the frame and said vague things (SMARTER EVERY DAY)
lessons.rule: Headlines are one short line (30 characters at most) stating a specific fact: a number, a name or a step

lessons.symptom: The product appeared once, as a three-line dialog; the references show the app in use in most shots
lessons.rule: A film about a product shows it in use (app-screen views: files, note, graph, chat, terminal) in at least a third of its claim beats

lessons.symptom: The host peeked from behind the machine, half hidden at the frame edge, and mostly watched
lessons.rule: The host stands in front of the machine, inside the frame, acting on it

lessons.symptom: Flat vector fills and bright pastel walls read as clean illustration, not paper
lessons.rule: Rooms are muted crumpled paper with the bright colour on the objects (look cut-paper or object/room palettes with the dusk family)

lessons.symptom: 43.6 s against the references' 20-30 s
lessons.rule: Keep adaptations near 30 s (35 s at most): cut beats rather than speed up the voice

lessons.symptom: the product sticker floats over screen content (covers 3 GAPS, SAVED and a graph node) and the host covers the crate's items
lessons.rule: Brand stickers and the host never cover a machine or screen label

lessons.symptom: the CTA headline was cut at four words and read BUILD IT ONCE USE
lessons.rule: A headline stops at the end of a phrase: whole clauses, never cut mid-phrase

lessons.symptom: 5 of 12 sets showed the same striped wall, so new rooms still read as one place
lessons.rule: Consecutive sets never share a wall pattern and no wall covers more than a third of the sets; papered rooms take a per-beat wallpaper

lessons.symptom: Memo stood and watched in 9 of 12 frames
lessons.rule: The host acts on the object: for machines it feeds it carries a note in and throws it in at the contact

lessons.symptom: the terminal read '> cd sec' and the chat sat half blank for most of their shots
lessons.rule: App screens are mostly full on the first frame and finish fast; give terminal and chat views several lines of real content

lessons.source: Claude review of second-brain cut 6 stills
lessons.symptom: the terminal's CLAUDE IS IN sticker and the file tree's VAULT READY sticker covered screen lines
lessons.rule: A machine's labels never sit on each other; result stickers on text screens go below the text

lessons.source: Claude motion study, cut 6 vs seven references
lessons.symptom: cut 6 drifted as much as the references but changed the whole picture 0.6 times a second (refs 0.7-1.9) and had 0.8 large changes a second (refs 1.1-4.3)
lessons.rule: Raise sudden-change rates with things that happen in the scene; the motion stage reports picture changes and large changes per second (refs 0.7-1.9 and 1.1-4.3) but does not gate them (see L027)

lessons.symptom: hard snap zooms inside each shot (to hit motion targets) looked choppy, not smooth; cut 6 looked better
lessons.rule: Camera moves inside a shot are eased, never hard snaps; do not chase a motion number with the camera. Mayowa's eye beats the metric
